extension.description: Generates Conventional Commits messages from your changes with the Claude Code CLI (uses your subscription, no API key).
command.generate.title: Generate Commit Message with Claude
command.cancel.title: Stop Generating the Commit Message
settings.model.comment: Model passed to the CLI as `--model`.
settings.model.custom.comment: Custom model: any model name or alias accepted by `claude --model`. When filled in, it replaces **Model**.
settings.effort.comment: Effort passed to the CLI as `--effort`. Lower effort answers a little sooner.
settings.cli.path.comment: Path to the Claude CLI. Leave empty to find `claude` automatically. Fill it in if the extension cannot find it, e.g. `/opt/homebrew/bin/claude`.
settings.fast.comment: Fast mode: replaces the default Claude Code system prompt with only the commit rules and skips MCP servers, so Claude answers sooner. Same model and rules.
settings.imitate.comment: Match the style of recent commits: sends the titles of the last 20 commits to Claude as a reference.
settings.scope.comment: Always include a scope, for example `feat(settings): …` instead of `feat: …`, even if recent commits do not use scopes.
settings.extra.comment: Additional instructions added to the prompt on every request, e.g. "Explain why in the body" or "Put the ticket ID at the end".
settings.overwrite: Replace the existing message without asking.
